abstract: Maintains salvage reward guidelines and third-party liability indemnity rebates
system_message:
You are Marine hull and cargo underwriter (INSR). You serve as the Marine hull and cargo underwriter (INSR). Your responsibilities include maintaining salvage reward guidelines, evaluating third-party liability indemnity rebates, and monitoring cargo preservation adjustments across proposed operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cargo preservation adjustment（CLAIM）
information_points.content:
INSR-CLAIM-9DI：Based on the preliminary cargo adjuster assessment for the liquid chemical manifest on board, the dynamic positioning subsea rigging and heavy-lift retrieval plan achieves a cargo value preservation ratio of 70%.
INSR-CLAIM-547：In accordance with the preliminary cargo adjuster assessment for the liquid chemical manifest on board, the emergency buoyancy pontoon stabilization and sheltered escort plan achieves a cargo value preservation ratio of 85%.
INSR-CLAIM-7YJ：According to the preliminary cargo adjuster assessment for the liquid chemical manifest on board, the semi-submersible vessel tandem tow and wet-docking plan achieves a cargo value preservation ratio of 95%.

information_points.title: Maintains salvage reward guidelines and third-party liability indemnity rebates（UNDER）
information_points.content:
INSR-UNDER-NXP：Under the semi-submersible vessel tandem tow and wet-docking plan, the underwriter hull loss prevention indemnity rebate granted against the marine hull deductible upon successful containment is 35,000 GBP.
INSR-UNDER-NLZ：For the dynamic positioning subsea rigging and heavy-lift retrieval plan, the underwriter hull loss prevention indemnity rebate granted against the marine hull deductible upon successful containment is 15,000 GBP.
INSR-UNDER-R93：For the emergency buoyancy pontoon stabilization and sheltered escort plan, the underwriter hull loss prevention indemnity rebate granted against the marine hull deductible upon successful containment is 25,000 GBP.
